tickets.summary: TWTAI Capstone Project — Complete End-to-End System Development and Deployment
tickets.description: Epic tracking the full capstone system build and rollout across architecture, backend, frontend, testing, and deployment.

Finalize system architecture: database schema, API design, service boundaries, and integration diagram. Produce a technical stack document and complete 15+ component specs. Architecture review approved.
Implement 50+ REST API endpoints, 20+ database tables, authentication and authorization, and centralized error handling and logging. API documentation completed.
Build 20+ responsive UI screens including user dashboard and admin panel. Fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop. Meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
Completed 50+ unit tests, 30+ integration tests, and 20+ end-to-end tests, achieving 80%+ code coverage. Performance testing and a security assessment completed. CI/CD test automation in place.
Complete 15+ documentation pages and deploy the system to production.
